name: length_takeUntil_le
statement: V} (p : G.Walk v w) (h : u ∈ p.support) : (p.takeUntil u h).length ≤ p.length

name: length_dropUntil_le
statement: V} (p : G.Walk v w) (h : u ∈ p.support) : (p.dropUntil u h).length ≤ p.length

name: getVert_length_takeUntil
statement: G.Walk v w} (h : u ∈ p.support) : p.getVert (p.takeUntil _ h).length = u

name: getVert_lt_length_takeUntil_ne
statement: ℕ} {p : G.Walk v w} (h : u ∈ p.support) (hn : n < (p.takeUntil _ h).length) : p.getVert n ≠ u

name: notMem_support_takeUntil_support_takeUntil_subset
statement: G.Walk u v} {w x : V} (h : x ≠ w) (hw : w ∈ p.support) (hx : x ∈ (p.takeUntil w hw).support) : w ∉ (p.takeUntil x (p.support_takeUntil_subset hw hx)).support

have_tree.name: h2
have_tree.type: ((p.takeUntil w hw).takeUntil x hx).length < (p.takeUntil w hw).length
